landing_page.structure: Hero (Split) -> Features (Grid) -> How It Works (Steps) -> Testimonials -> CTA -> Footer
landing_page.hero_style: Left: Big Headline + CTA. Right: Hero Image with floating 'Savings' badge.
landing_page.bg_style: Warm Stone-50 background with subtle noise texture.

simulator.structure: Centered Wizard Card. Top: Progress Bar. Middle: Question + Options Grid. Bottom: Navigation (Back/Next).
simulator.animation: AnimatePresence mode='wait'. Variants: enter { x: 50, opacity: 0 }, center { x: 0, opacity: 1 }, exit { x: -50, opacity: 0 }.

result_page.structure: Dashboard Layout. Top: Summary (System Size, Monthly Savings). Middle: Charts/Details (Payback, CO2). Bottom: Lead Capture Modal (Persistent).

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar Layout. Main Content: Data Table with Filters. Top: KPI Cards.
admin_dashboard.style: Dense, clean, white background cards on light gray canvas.

hero_main.usage: Landing page hero section right side

family_trust.alt: Happy family in front of home

tech_detail.usage: Technical specs or 'How it works' background

general: Use 'Manrope' for all headings to give a distinct modern feel.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 (#0F172A) for text.
Always add 'hover:scale-105' or similar micro-interactions to clickable cards.
Ensure all inputs have 'data-testid' for testing.
Simulator steps must feel like a conversation, not a form.

simulator_logic.step_3: Location (City/State - Auto-fetch irradiation if possible, else mock)
simulator_logic.result: Show: kWp, # Panels, Inverter, Payback Time, Monthly Savings.
